[Thinking]
**Creating feedback template**

The user is asking for a template to give feedback to their manager after a B2B sales visit to a small business branch. I need to provide a concise email or report template with essential fields like objectives, meeting summaries, contact information, and next steps.

I should consider creating both short and long versions and suggest subject line options. I'll also include placeholders and bullet points to make it easily fillable. Let's work on delivering a clear, fill-in template that meets these needs!
[/Thinking]

Here’s a concise, fill-in template you can use to brief your manager after the visit.

Subject: Visit Report – [Business Name] (Branch) – [Date]

Hi [Manager Name],

Purpose of Visit
- Objective: [e.g., Introduce [Product/Service], qualify fit, gather decision-making info]
- Target profile: [Industry, size, key use case]

Visit Summary
- Date/Time/Location: [DD/MM/YYYY, Time, Address]
- Contact met (Role): [Name, Title]
- Discovery: This location is a branch. Decision-making handled by head office.
- Head office contact provided: [Email], [Name/Role if known]

Business Context & Needs
- Current setup/tools: [Brief]
- Pain points: [List top 1–3]
- Budget/timeframe (if shared): [e.g., Q3 review, TBD]
- Competitors in play: [If any]

Decision-Making & Stakeholders
- Branch influence: [e.g., Can recommend; no purchasing authority]
- Head office stakeholders to engage: [Titles/Functions if known]
- Procurement process (if known): [Brief steps]

Fit & Opportunity
- Proposed solution: [Product/Package]
- Value levers: [e.g., cost savings, efficiency, compliance]
- Deal size estimate: [Range or TBD]
- Probability/Stage: [e.g., Early qualify]

Next Steps
- My actions:
  - Email head office at [email] with intro/deck by [date]
  - Attach case studies relevant to [industry]
  - Schedule discovery call with HO stakeholders [proposed dates]
- Branch follow-up:
  - Send recap to branch contact [name] to keep them looped in
- Ask from you:
  - Warm intro from [exec/region lead] to HO if possible
  - Approval for [discount/trial/POC parameters]
  - Share any prior history with this account

Risks/Blocks
- [e.g., Centralized procurement, long cycle, existing vendor lock-in]
- Mitigation: [e.g., pilot proposal, ROI model, security/compliance docs ready]

Attachments/Materials
- Leave-behind used: [Brochure/version]
- Files to send to HO: [Deck, Case study, Pricing one-pager]
- Photos/notes (if any): [Stored in CRM link]

Admin
- Logged in CRM: [Yes/No] – Link: [URL]
- Expenses: [If applicable]
- Next update by: [Date]

Key Takeaway
- [One-sentence summary: Real buyer is HO; positive interest at branch; need HO discovery]

Thanks,
[Your Name]
[Title | Phone]

Optional subject lines:
- Branch Visit Report – [Business Name] → HO Contact Secured
- [Business Name] (Branch) – HO Lead Identified, Next Steps
- Post-Visit Update: [City] Branch of [Business Name] – Routing to HO

If you want, I can tailor this to your industry and product.
